subject: FinTechCo deployment: SSO / KMS / logging follow-up
messages:
From: Alice Zhao <alice.zhao@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rahul Desai <r.desai@fintechco.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: deployment constraints (SSO, KMS, logging)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo earlier — helpful overview. I wanted to summarize our key deployment constraints so we can continue the qualification:

- SSO: FinTechCo uses SAML (Okta) + SCIM for user provisioning. We need SSO integration and SCIM support (automated provisioning/deprovisioning).
- KMS/HSM: Customer-managed keys are required for encryption at rest for model payloads and logs. We prefer an HSM-backed KMS (AWS CloudHSM / BYOK) or equivalent where we can control key rotation and access.
- Logging retention & export: For audit and regulatory reasons, security logs and API audit trails must be retained for 5-7 years. We need the ability to forward logs to our SIEM (S3 bucket or a syslog endpoint) with envelope encryption using our KMS.

Given those constraints, our security team is leaning toward a private deployment (VPC or on-prem), but they indicated Dedicated could be acceptable if it supports BYOK/HSM and private networking (VPC peering / private link) with log export. Hosted API likely won't meet the KMS requirement.

Next steps from our side: can you confirm whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS/HSM in Dedicated, and what your logging export and retention options look like? Also please send a short checklist of docs/security evidence we should gather before an architecture call.

Thanks — Alice

-- 
Alice Zhao
Head of Security Ops, FinTechCo
alice.zhao@fintechco.com
(415) 555-0123
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhao <alice.zhao@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: deployment constraints (SSO, KMS, logging)

Alice — really appreciate the clear summary, and great to meet your team today. High level answers below, plus proposed next steps:

Quick answers:
- Hosted API: designed for fastest time-to-value; does NOT support customer-managed KMS/HSM or private peering. Not likely to meet your BYOK/HSM requirement.
- Dedicated: reserved capacity with private networking (VPC peering/PrivateLink) and limited BYOK support. We can integrate with customer-managed KMS for model payloads and S3 exports in many configurations; full HSM integration is subject to architecture review and SOC/legal approval — we have customers using AWS KMS with customer key material.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): provides the most control — customer-managed KMS/HSM, private control plane, and full log export/retention controls. This is the recommended path for strict regulatory requirements.

Logging/export: we support exporting audit logs and request/response traces to customer S3 or a SIEM via forwarders. Retention is configurable when you control the storage (recommended for 5-7 year retention). For Dedicated, we offer log forwarding but retention policies are typically managed on your side (S3 lifecycle), or we can offer a retention add-on where Redwood retains and encrypts logs per contract.

Attachments: I’m attaching a short brief that outlines deployment options and typical integrations (redwood-deployment-options-brief.pdf).

Proposed next steps:
1) Can you confirm the specific KMS/HSM product and requirements (AWS KMS with CloudHSM CMKs, HSM appliance, etc.)?
2) Would you like to schedule an architecture call with our solution architect (Rishi) and account lead (Monica)? We can run a deep-dive on BYOK, SCIM/SSO, and log pipelines.
3) Please share any security questionnaires or the list of docs your team needs. We’ll collect SOC2, pen test summaries, and integration checklists.

If it helps, Rishi and Monica are copied and available next week. How does Mon, 24 Aug 2026 at 10:00 PT look for a 45-min call?

— Marissa

Attachments: redwood-deployment-options-brief.pdf
From: Alice Zhao <alice.zhao@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rahul Desai <r.desai@fintechco.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: deployment constraints (SSO, KMS, logging)

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clarity. A few clarifications from Security/Infra: 

- KMS/HSM: our preferred pattern is BYOK with an HSM-backed key (AWS CloudHSM protected CMKs or an equivalent HSM). We need key import or CloudHSM-backed KMS where FinTechCo controls key material and rotation.
- SSO/SCIM: must support SAML 2.0 and SCIM v2 for automated provisioning.
- Logs: we will require delivery to our S3 bucket (encrypted with our KMS) and support for long-term retention policies (5-7 years). Additionally, we need tamper-evident audit trails and time-synced logs for regulatory review.

Given that, priority is: Private VPC/on-prem > Dedicated (if you can guarantee BYOK/HSM + private networking) > Hosted (not acceptable for primary deployment).

We have a short security requirements spreadsheet — attaching it (security_requirements.xlsx). Could you and Rishi review and flag any items you foresee being blockers?

Also, Mon/Tue next week works. The proposed Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:00 PT is fine for our CTO Rahul and myself. Please send a calendar invite.

Best,
Alice

Attachments: security_requirements.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Zhao <alice.zhao@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: deployment constraints (SSO, KMS, logging)

Alice / Rahul — great, glad Monday works. I’ll get a calendar invite out shortly.

High-level notes for the architecture call and what we’ll cover:
- Confirm KMS path: discuss your preferred AWS CloudHSM + CMK flow vs. HSM appliance. Rishi will map out integration patterns (BYOK import, CloudHSM-backed CMK, or HSM gateway).
- SSO/SCIM: our engineering team supports SAML 2.0 and SCIM v2. We’ll share our SCIM attribute mappings and provisioning guide in the call.
- Logging & retention: options for forwarding audit logs to your S3 (encrypted with your KMS), retention policies, and tamper-evidence controls (WORM, checksum approaches). We’ll surface our standard audit logging schema.
- Deployment options decision criteria: quick checklist to decide Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private based on regulatory and control needs.

Pre-call ask of FinTechCo security: please confirm the specific KMS/HSM product (CloudHSM cluster id or vendor), S3 bucket destination for logs, and any mandatory compliance evidence items in the sheet. That will help Rishi prepare a targeted feasibility plan.

I attached a short MVP integration proposal that outlines a stepwise approach (proposed_MVP_integration_plan.pdf). For timeline planning, if the architecture is approved we can scope a Dedicated pilot in ~6-8 weeks or a Private deployment on a slightly longer cadence depending on network and KMS work.

Invite: scheduled Mon, 24 Aug 2026 10:00 PT — invite will go to the emails used here.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

— Marissa

Attachments: proposed_MVP_integration_plan.pdf
